data.long_meaning: A name signifying a feeling of contentment and comfort, derived from the Arabic root 'rakha' which means to protect or provide shelter. The name Rakhaa carries the meaning “Contentment, Comfort” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Rakhaa usually hope their child will grow to embody contentment, comfort and live with faith, good character and purpose.
